title: Create story plugin in the storyhook claude plugin marketplace which mirrors the behavior of the /issue plugin in the mikeydotio/agentics marketplace, but for storyhook stories instead of github issues.

text: [git] d2fce75: chore(storyhook): file three plugin defects found while scoping SH-45

Delivered full /issue parity for the /story plugin.

bin/story.sh went from 1 subcommand to 7: dispatch (existing) plus
complete (plan|execute), view, list, create, doctor, capture.

Skill layer: bare /story is now List -> Pick (was project context -- a
deliberate breaking change for parity; /story context still gives the
overview), /story <id> is View + Offer, and new/complete lazy-load
protocol files from references/.

Forks follow the precedent set by issue #40: complete from agentics'
plugins/storywork, the rest from plugins/issue, each with a provenance
header. lib/session.sh needed no changes -- its git-safety block and
pane helpers were already vendored and had zero callers until now.

Two deviations from a literal port, both deliberate:
- complete closes the story (storywork leaves state alone because
  conductor owns the transition; /issue complete closes the issue, and
  parity is the ask). --no-close/--no-clean give back each half.
- doctor runs BOTH the tmux readiness-drift probe and `story doctor`
  project integrity, since the CLI already owns that verb name.

Also fixed SH-46 as a prerequisite (every story call now anchored to the
project root) and filed SH-47/SH-48 for two unrelated defects found
while scoping.

Tests: 15 plugin cases (was 6), including the first coverage of the
skill layer, which was previously untested prose. Verified end-to-end
against real tmux and real git: list -> dispatch -> capture -> view ->
complete plan -> complete execute, with the worktree and branch
reclaimed and the story closed.

Known behavior, matching /issue: complete does not kill the dispatched
tmux window. Killing a window could destroy an in-flight session, and
the scrollback is often still wanted.
